$description: Reven Brand System design tokens. Source of truth: brand/source/Reven_Brand_Guidelines.pdf (v1.0, July 2026). Do not add a value here that is not defined in the brand guidelines — extend the guidelines first.

meta.rule: Blue is the only saturated hue in the system. Everything else is navy, cream, or gray.

status.$comment: Use sparingly, never as a primary color.

body.use: All reading copy, pill labels, quoted lines.

label.use: Every eyebrow, index and footer meta. Never body copy.

accentChip.note: Two-tone Accent Blue block breaking the R's counter and the foot of the n. The only permitted color break in the mark.

period.note: The trailing period in 'Reven.' always renders in Accent Blue.

logo.clearspace: ≥ the accent chip's height on every side
logo.rule: Exactly one wordmark. No condensed cut, no icon-only mark, no alternate lockups.

split.rule: Body is asymmetric — never an even 50/50 split.

layout.headline: max-width · text-wrap: balance · exactly one accent clause

motif.name: node-and-flow constellation
motif.where: Dark-navy or gradient-tinted slides only — never on flat cream.
motif.emphasisNode: At most one glowing node per slide.

radius.$comment: Observed from the guideline components (cards, pills, panels). Provided for implementation convenience; tune per surface.
